message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that’s done only once every seven years or so. In practice, the whole process—from cleaning and priming to applying the final coat—takes roughly **two months**. That’s why you’ll see the tower covered in scaffolding and workers for a short period before the next repaint.
